title: Class Scheduling System
shortDesc: Room allocation & conflict detection for instructors and classrooms. Includes printing.
longDesc:
Room allocation & conflict detection for instructors and classrooms. Includes printing. Built with HTML, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Python, and SQL.

Features:
• Automatic detection of allocation conflicts
• Room, instructor, and time management
• Prevent duplication and confusion
• Interactive calendar view
• Printable schedules
• Export to PDF
